source_row.extraction_instructions: eZ Publish, server-rendered. /Courses has one a.single-content-item per course with 'Title - dates' in p.navigation-link and a one-line blurb; undated and past cards are skipped, PCR Gulf Valves (302 to GulfPCR-GIM) is dropped as a duplicate. Course page: Event JSON-LD (regex-read, sometimes invalid JSON) gives venue/city/country, dates come from the card. Fees on the course's own /Register page: .pricing-item packages (category, current price for the pricing-active timeframe, other timeframes as price-text/price-small), Innovators Day uses its STAND ALONE matrix. Exhibitor/industry/emerging-company categories are skipped.

registry_comment: PCR courses (EuroPCR family): /Courses cards -> course page JSON-LD venue + /Register pricing-item fees (EUR/SGD)

spot_check.site_says: Late rate active: Nurses/Allied/Fellows EUR 775, Physicians EUR 1490, Digital package EUR 500 (Onsite 900/1600/500); VAT included
Fellow 1,020 SGD, Physicians 1,270 SGD (Regular on sale, Early sold out)
spot_check.extractor_says: Registration · Fellow · Regular 1020 SGD; Physicians 1270 SGD

spot_check.extractor_says: 750 / 1000 / 0 SGD (free row takes the page currency)

concerns: Cards without a date ('PCR Fellows Course | Paris', 'The Physiology Course 2026') and past courses (PCR-CIT Chengdu 11-13 Sep 2026, Transseptal Puncture 15-16 Sep 2026) are skipped; 17 cards -> 12 shells.

PCR Gulf Valves is dropped through a hard-coded alias map because /Courses/PCR-Gulf-Valves 302-redirects to /Courses/GulfPCR-GIM (same event, same dates). If PCR adds new redirecting cards, extend _ALIASES.

Course-page JSON-LD can be stale: Alfieri's Bootcamp says 2026-10-22 while the card and page text say 9-11 November 2026. Dates therefore always come from the listing card; JSON-LD is used for venue/city/country only, and a location name equal to the page title is discarded (4 pages).

Fees: 7 of 12 courses show public fees; the other 5 have no /Register page (GulfPCR-GIM, PCR Tokyo Valves, SASCI-AfricaPCR, AVAM, PCR Rio Valves) so tiers are empty. Registration for several 2027 courses has not opened ('Registration will open soon') but prices are printed.

Exhibitor, industry-representative and emerging-company rates are dropped (not delegate fees). Onsite (door) prices are dropped; only the current timeframe plus later published timeframes are stored. Digital-only fees are stored as 'Digital'.

Alfieri's Bootcamp prints '3400 EUR HT - 4148 EUR TTC'; the VAT-inclusive 4148 is stored. PCR Innovators Day: the pricing-item block is the EuroPCR bundle, so the 'STAND ALONE' matrix is used (labelled 'Innovators Day stand-alone'). Innovators Day has no JSON-LD, so no venue (Paris is only in prose).

event_type: PCR calls everything a 'Course'. Per the PLAYBOOK 3-way rule, short (<=3 day) Fellows Course / Bootcamp / Pre-course / Innovators Day are 'workshop' (4), the multi-day meetings (EuroPCR, London/Tokyo/Rio/Gulf Valves, AICT-AsiaPCR, SASCI, AVAM) are 'conference' (8); EuroPCR carries is_flagship. A reviewer may prefer 'course' for all.

The 'Pre-course on cardiogenic shock' card links to /Network/iHF-Improving-Heart-Failure-care/Pre-course (same host, different section); it parses the same way (Physician 325 Regular / 375 Late EUR, Fellow 225 / 275).
About 12 course pages + 7 Register pages + 1 listing = about 20 requests per scrape at 1 s gap. Forced-fallback run gave the same 12 shells.

event_format is now always set (in_person unless title/blurb says webinar/online/virtual: none do). Innovators Day has no JSON-LD, so its city (Paris) is read from the Register page sentence 'join us in Paris on 17 May 2027'; all 12 rows now have a city.
